sectors.trend: Nasdaq at all-time high; AI stocks (AMD $1T, CoreWeave, Hinge Health) rally, but 10-year yield surge and 'AI swarm' concerns create volatility. Warning signs flashing despite rally.
sectors.implications: AI remains primary market driver but concentration risk is elevated. Yield sensitivity makes high-multiple tech vulnerable to any rate surprise. Chinese AI exporters outperforming domestic firms signals global AI race intensifying.

sectors.trend: Oil tumbles to 2-week low below $100 on Iran diplomacy and pipeline reopening hopes. Ryanair trims flights as oil ticks up intermittently. Diesel export policy debate active.
sectors.implications: Oil volatility creates two-way risk. Iran talks success could suppress prices further, benefiting consumers but pressuring energy equities. Diesel export proposals could reshape US fuel pricing.

sectors.trend: 10-year yield at new high; Fed's Barr signals more hikes. PGIM's Peters notes improving financial conditions. CD rates up to 4.40% APY; mortgage rates finding room to fall.
sectors.implications: Rising yields compress equity valuations, especially growth. Higher-for-longer rate environment favors financials and value. Bond investors face reinvestment risk but attractive yields.

sectors.trend: Viking Therapeutics obesity drug data drives sector rotation. Starbucks $1B cafe makeover. McDonald's investor day amid US struggles. Peloton cheapest treadmill for turnaround. CVS Q2 strength.
sectors.implications: Healthcare showing idiosyncratic catalysts. Consumer discretionary mixed—premium brands investing, value segments struggling. Obesity drug competition intensifying.

sectors.trend: India RBI sees rupee appreciation case; antitrust clears L'Oreal/Onesto. Turkey investors chase lost savings post-funds meltdown. Kenya Quickmart Nairobi listing. Ethiopia Tigray airport seized.
sectors.implications: EM diverging sharply. India strengthening, Turkey in distress. Geopolitical instability in Africa and Middle East creating localized risks. China-US AI competition shaping global tech flows.

sectors.trend: Bitcoin and Ethereum near 8-month highs. Binance $100M Circle investment. Gold holds on China/Iran uncertainty. Silver settles ahead of US-China summit. Copper retreats from near-record.
sectors.implications: Risk-on sentiment in crypto despite macro headwinds. Precious metals acting as geopolitical hedge. Copper pullback signals demand concerns or Fed-driven risk-off in commodities.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in fixed income; favor short-duration bonds; hedge equity beta with inverse ETFs; increase allocation to rate-insensitive sectors (utilities, healthcare).
Diversify beyond mega-cap AI names; monitor 'AI swarm' regulatory developments; balance with value and non-tech holdings; watch for AI capex digestion in earnings.
Maintain 10-15% allocation to gold and defense equities; monitor oil supply disruptions; avoid overexposure to EM in conflict zones.
Hedge with TLT short positions or VIX calls; favor cash-equivalent yields (4.40% CD); reduce leverage in portfolio.
Avoid heavy China exposure pre-summit; monitor AI export control language; prepare for potential tariff or tech decoupling announcements.
Monitor for regulatory spillover into media/tech sectors; avoid overconcentration in politically exposed names.

market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. 10-year yield surge and Fed hawkishness create headwinds, but AI-driven Nasdaq momentum and oil relief provide offset. Trump-Xi summit and Iran talks are binary catalysts. Expect range-bound with sharp intraday swings. Small caps under pressure. Watch for yield-driven tech rotation.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive. S&P 500 25%+ earnings growth for third quarter supports equities. AI secular trend intact despite skepticism. Higher rates normalize but don't break growth. Value rotation may broaden market participation. Geopolitical risks remain but diplomacy (Iran, US-China) offers de-escalation paths.
